body:
# Souls of might
### The datapack is also a texturepack so do not forget to add it to your texture packs and datapacks!
_Are you bored of the typical lifesteal or infuse twists on minecraft servers and want something different? Then this is the perfect datapack for you! It adds 40 custom souls with unique abilities that you can combine into your own personal combination._
Extra tip: disallow potion effects in combat on your server to make players use the souls to its full potential.


## 3 types of souls:
1. Blue souls: All blue souls give a passive buff that will always be active. You can put them in the 5 blue slots at the top of your survival inventory that the texture pack adds. 
2. Green souls: All green souls give an effect when you hit a target. You can put them in the 3 green slots at the top of your survival inventory that the texture pack adds.
3. Purple souls: All purple souls are very powerful superpowers that you can activate with the newly added 'Spiritual Gem' item when your manabar is full. You can put them in the 1 purple slot at the top of your survival inventory that the texture pack adds.

## Other items:
- Neutral soul: a soul that has no superpowers yet, and that can be used as the base to craft the colored souls. You can unlock the recipe by obtaining soul sand.
- Spiritual Gem: a gem that you can right click when you have a purple soul in the purple slot of your inventory and when your manabar is full to activate your powerful ability.

# Spoilers!


## Blue souls:
- Soul of aqua: Gives dolphins grace, conduit power 1 and water breathing
- Soul of balance: Gives you a lot of smaller effects - Water breathing, speed 1, strength 1, hero of the village 1, luck 1 and haste 1
- Soul of demons: Increases damage the lower your health gets - You can stack this damage with any type of strength and note that when you are at full health you deal lower damage then normal
- Soul of giants: Makes you bigger - Also increases jump strength, movement speed, step height, block interaction range, and entity reach (this can stack with effects)
- Soul of gnomes: Makes you smaller - For smaller hitbox
- Soul of haste: Gives you haste 2
- Soul of hopping: Gives you jumpboost 3
- Soul of luck: Gives you hero of the village 3 and luck 3
- Soul of magic: Gives you resistance 2 but uses xp for it - When you do not have enough xp it will not do anything
- Soul of magma: Gives you fire resistance and strength 1
- Soul of mana: Gives you weakness 1 but doubles your mana recharge speed for using purple souls
- Soul of power: Gives you strength 2
- Soul of protection: Gives you resistance 1
- Soul of regeneration: Heals you over time - It will not give you regeneration but just heals you every 10 seconds
- Soul of restoration: Gives you saturation over time - Gives you saturation every 5 seconds (saturation = food)
- Soul of speed: Gives you speed 2
- Soul of stealth: Gives you invisibility, strength 1 and speed 1
## Green souls:
- Soul of area: Summons evoker fangs on hit in front of you - Good for damage on multiple enemies
- Soul of blood: Does instant damage 1 to you and your opponent on hit
- Soul of confusion: Inflicts darkness for 5 seconds and blindness for 1 second on hit
- Soul of dullness: Inflicts weakness 1 for 3 seconds on hit
- Soul of holy: Gives you regeneration 3 for 5 seconds on hit but also inflicts regeneration 2 for 5 seconds on the target you hit.
- Soul of lightning: Attracts lightning on hit
- Soul of limitation: Inflicts slowness 1 and mining fatigue 1 for 3 seconds on hit
- Soul of locking: Locks the target to the center of the block he is standing on on hit
- Soul of rage: Gives you weakness 1 but also gives strength 4 on hit for 1 second - This means that the first hit will be weak but all the hits within 1 second after the last hit will be really strong
- Soul of unholy: Kills the target on hit if he becomes 1 heart or lower
- Soul of vampires: Gives you regeneration 3 for 1 second on hit
- Soul of vision: Inflicts glowing 1 on hit for 1 minute
- Soul of warping: Teleports you in a 1 block radius on hit - Also teleports you to the highest point that is not air
- Soul of wither: Inflicts wither 2 for 5 seconds on hit
## Purple souls:
- Soul of beaming: Shoots out a beam for 10 seconds
- Soul of bursting: Launches you in the air and makes you burst down with a big explosion
- Soul of chronology: Freezes the closest entity you look at for 15 seconds
- Soul of healing: heals you and the player you look at
- Soul of honey: gives you absorption (extra health) and summons angry bees around you
- Soul of invincibility: makes you invincible and gives you strength 3 for 10 seconds
- Soul of meteors: rains down meteors at all close players
- Soul of swiftness: Teleports you randomly in a 500 block radius
- Soul of void: Exiles a player for 30 seconds - The player will be in the void but can not die

Thats enough spoilers, download it already! :D
